from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional
import dacite
@dataclass
class Leg:
    """
    A segment of a trip between two locations with one mode of transport
    """
    pageTitle:str
    num:Optional[float] # sequence number of the leg within the trip
    date:Optional[str] # day the leg is travelled
    from:Optional[str] # id of the start location of the leg
    to:Optional[str] # id of the end location of the leg
    transport:Optional[str] # mode of transport of the leg
    distance:Optional[float] # distance of the leg in km
    duration:Optional[str] # travel time of the leg e.g. 2h30
    operator:Optional[str] # operator or line e.g. Trenitalia IC 604, Jadrolinija
    booking:Optional[str] # url of the booking or timetable of the leg
    track:Optional[str] # cycle.travel journey id of the route of the leg
    stay:Optional[str] # id of the location where the night after this leg is spent
    notes:Optional[str] # notes on the leg

    @classmethod
    def askQuery(cls):
        """
        get the ask Query for Leg

        Returns:
            str: the mediawiki markup for the ask query
        """
        ask="""{{#ask: [[Concept:Leg]]
|mainlabel=pageTitle
|?Leg num = num
|?Leg date = date
|?Leg from = from
|?Leg to = to
|?Leg transport = transport
|?Leg distance = distance
|?Leg duration = duration
|?Leg operator = operator
|?Leg booking = booking
|?Leg track = track
|?Leg stay = stay
|?Leg notes = notes
|limit=10000
|format=table
}}"""
        return ask

    @classmethod
    def fromDict(cls,data:dict):
        """
        create a Leg from the given dict

        Args:
            data(dict): the dict to create the Leg from

        Returns:
            Leg: the freshly created Leg
        """
        leg=dacite.from_dict(data_class=cls,data=data)
        return leg
